title: Postgres-migration-ready — code + migrations work on both SQLite and Postgres
context: P0-01 in the roadmap. Enterprise buyers won't accept a SQLite-backed prod. We don't want to force everyone off SQLite for local dev, though — the current test suite spins a fresh SQLite per test file, which is fast and hermetic. The change is to make the code dialect-portable and prove it in CI, then flip TREASURY_DATABASE_URL in each real deployment.
decision: Keep SQLite as the default for local dev + the existing pytest suite. Make every migration and every SQLAlchemy model portable to Postgres, add psycopg[binary] as an unconditional dependency (only used when the URL says so), and add a CI job that runs alembic upgrade head + seed against a real Postgres 16 service container.
scope_in: All Index() sites now carry BOTH sqlite_where= AND postgresql_where= with matching predicates. 8 in models.py, 16 in migrations — a partial unique index on SQLite silently degrades to a full unique index on Postgres without this, which would then reject legitimate rows.
alembic env.py: render_as_batch is now dialect-conditional (SQLite only). batch_alter_table calls inside migrations still work on Postgres (Alembic falls through to direct DDL).
.github/workflows/ci.yml: new job 'postgres-migrations' — postgres:16 service, alembic upgrade head, python -m seed.seed, FastAPI boot smoke.
docker-compose.yml at repo root: one-liner for a dev to smoke Postgres locally.
scope_out_deferred: Running the full pytest suite against Postgres — parametrising conftest across dialects is a follow-up. The migrations-and-seed job in CI already catches the class of dialect breaks (partial indexes, batch mode, constraint syntax) that would silently ship otherwise.
Removing SQLite as a supported dialect. It stays: dev is fast, tests are hermetic, the demo VM already runs it. Every real customer deployment sets TREASURY_DATABASE_URL to Postgres.
Read replicas, connection pooling tuning, PgBouncer — future work when we know the load shape.
invariants: Partial unique indexes carry both dialect kwargs. A future Index() that adds only sqlite_where will trip the CI Postgres job the moment a real user hits the 'only one current row' invariant.
The default TREASURY_DATABASE_URL stays SQLite; a real deploy overrides it via env or the vault (see P0-06).

psycopg is bundled in the requirements file even for SQLite installs. It's tiny and installs from a wheel; the alternative — a separate requirements-postgres.txt — was rejected as a footgun in production.
consequences: backend/app/models.py — every partial Index() now dual-dialect
backend/alembic/env.py — render_as_batch flipped off on Postgres
backend/alembic/versions/*.py — every create_index/drop_index sqlite_where gained a postgresql_where sibling
docker-compose.yml — new file for local Postgres
